sources: Kit plan: docs/kit-batches/batch-2/chr_0023_antal.md (analysis 1 kit plan, re-analysed in its "Kit (2026-10-19)" section). Hit structure and frames: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0023_antal_* and Json/BuffData buff_chr_0023_antal_* (game 1.6), as compiled by efsim kit-draft v2 and corrected by hand where noted; values from SkillPatchTable (level 12: attack1–4 atk_scale 0.52 / 0.63 / 0.77 / 1.15, attack4 poise 15 and atb 15, finisher 9.0, dive 1.8, battle skill atk_scale 2.0, rate 0.10, duration 60, cost 100 SP; combo atk_scale 3.4, poise 10, usp 10, cooldown 24 s; ultimate rate 0.20, duration 12, cost 100, cooldown 20 s).

Basic attacks launch projectiles (LaunchProjectile with assignBlackboard): their damage is in the *_projhit files and logged under those keys, and they land even if the attack is cancelled (detached). attack3: two launches at 14 and 18 after one ModifyDynamicBlackboard atk_scale ×0.5. attack4: ×0.5, two launches at frame 27 of chr_0023_antal_attack4_powerattack_projhit, whose IfElse on the timed marker have_recovered (returnTrueIfNotExists) makes the first landing the Final Strike (mask 2097280, ObtainCostAction atb, poise onlyEnableForMainChar, CreateTimedMarker have_recovered 0.5 s) and the second a plain mask-128 hit without SP or stagger (hand-written: kit-draft gives each branch count 2). Finisher (power_attack, skillSpecification 8): BreakingAttackCalculation atk_scale × multiplier 0.06 at frames 10, 12, 14, 15, 16 (power_attack02_projhit) and × 0.7 at 25 (power_attack_projhit), hand-written factors; finisher SP is the engine's (GainBreakingAttackAtb).

Skill descriptions (CharGrowthTable + I18nTextTable_EN). Battle skill "Specified Research Subject": "Applies Focus with a long duration on the enemy and deals Electric DMG. An enemy with an active Focus also suffers Electric Susceptibility and Heat Susceptibility. Focus can only be applied to 1 enemy at any given time." Combo "EMP Test Site": "COMBO TRIGGER: When an enemy with active Focus suffers a Physical Status or Arts Infliction. Triggers 1 energy explosion on the enemy that deals Electric DMG and applies another stack of the same Physical Status or Arts Infliction." Ultimate "Overclocked Moment": "Applies temporary Electric Amp and Heat Amp to the entire team."

Combo application: chr_0023_antal_combo_skill frame 21, before its DamageAction, SwitchAction EntityBB_combo_type {0: by EntityBB_combo_index SpellInfliction Heat / Electric / Cryo / Nature; 1: AirborneAction (not forced) / KnockDownAction / FractureAction (Breach) / CrushAction damageMultiplier 1.0; 2: nothing}: the infliction or physical status of the event that opened the window (applications element: event / status: event; the latest event that opened or refreshed the window counts, assumed).

Talents and potentials. Talent 1 "Improviser" (buff_chr_0023_antal_talent_1: AuraAction, excludeOwner false, gives the team buff_chr_0023_antal_talent_1_heal_trigger): abilityEvent 13, CheckGlobalCDTimer, CheckTagMatch −1748167886 (Amp) on the ally, CheckDamageDecorateMask checkType 1 mask 8960 (battle, combo, ultimate), untagged HealAction, AddGlobalCDTimer cd (30 s, per operator). Talent 2 "Subconscious Act" (buff_chr_0023_antal_talent_2): abilityEvent 101 (Antal takes damage), CheckBuffStackNumAdvanced buff_common_dash = 0 (not dashing), CheckDamageType 0 (Physical), Probablity probability (0.30), then buff_common_damage_immune_talent 0.01 s and an untagged self-heal. P1 Amp rate ×1.1, P2 ultimate cost ×0.9, P4 Intellect +10 and Max HP +10% come through the stat panel and skill values. P3 (15 SP when an enemy with Focus is defeated, tageffect abilityEvent 8) isn't modelled: kills aren't (N1, deferred). P5: see the focus_p5 buffs.

Ultimate energy: max 100 (90 at P2); the combo's ObtainCostAction costType 0 gives himself usp 10 at frame 21; the battle skill gives the team its SP energy at frame 20 (buff_common_obtain_ultimate_sp). No RefrainObtainUsp in his files. Not modelled: the battle skill's HitStopAction (char_hard_stop 0.1 s; Ti1b), the dive attack in rotations (S10), the dash attack (SkillPatchTable only, no SkillData file).

Not verified against a log: no committed fixture has Antal. Unknowns (in-game tests proposed in the report): whether a physical status that only adds Vulnerable opens the combo (U1, here: no), whether an infliction that reacts at once opens it (U2, here: no), whether P5's +4% holds for the rest of Focus (U3, here: yes), whether his own Electric / Heat Amp carries the Amp tag talent 1 checks (U4, here: yes).

buffs.note: Battle skill frame 20: FinishBuffAction (the old Focus), CreateBuffAction buff_chr_0023_antal_normal_skill (rate, duration 60 s, P3/P5 keys) before the DamageAction; its start creates buff_chr_0023_antal_tageffect on the enemy: VulnerableAction subType 6 (Electric) and 4 (Heat) with rate (0.10 at level 12). A re-cast replaces it.

buffs.label: Focus: 20 s on the same target (P5 timer)
buffs.note: tageffect buffEvent 1: triggerInterval delay_time (0 below P5: not applied; 20 at P5), waitFirstTriggerInterval, maxTriggerCnt 1. A re-cast replaces it (the timer restarts without a buffEnded), so it only ends by running out 20 s after the latest Focus.

buffs.label: Focus held 20 s (P5): Electric and Heat Susceptibility +
buffs.note: tageffect's interval tick at P5 creates buff_chr_0023_antal_talent_1_combotrigger (0.1 s) on the enemy, which the VulnerableActions' enhancingList (operationType 1, + potential_5_rate 0.04) names. Assumed: the bonus holds for the rest of that Focus (U3). Lasts what Focus has left (60 − 20 s); the next battle skill ends it at its frame 20 (p5_reset).

buffs.label: Overclocked Moment: team Electric and Heat Amp
buffs.note: Ultimate frame 49: CreateBuffAction buff_chr_0023_antal_utimate_skill on every team member (CharacterTeamFinder) with duration (12 s) and rate (0.20 at level 12; P1 ×1.1): EnhancedAction subType 6 (Electric, icon_battle_affix_pulse_enhance) and 4 (Heat, icon_battle_affix_fire_enhance); stackingType 2 max 1.

triggers.note: CharGrowthTable: "COMBO TRIGGER: When an enemy with active Focus suffers a Physical Status or Arts Infliction." (infliction half). An infliction that reacts at once isn't an inflictionApplied (U2, in-game test 35 asks it for Arcane). The window records the element for the combo's element: event.

Physical Status half: Lift, Knock Down, Crush, Breach (the combo's switch has these four). A non-forced Lift / Knock Down on an enemy without Vulnerable only adds Vulnerable (a vulnerable event, not this one): assumed not to open the window (U1). The window records the status for the combo's status: event.
The ultimate has no DamageAction: its effect is the team buff at frame 49 (inside its cantCastSkill / cantSwitchPosition channel 0–56).
P5: Focus held delay_time (20 s) on the same target.
A new Focus (FinishBuffAction finishAll at frame 20) ends the P5 bonus of the old one. Not detached: a battle skill cut before frame 20 keeps it, as the game's FinishBuff would.

Talent 1: "After an Amped teammate's skill deals DMG, Antal restores the said teammate's HP [...] 1 time every {cd}s for each operator." Amped: any kit buff with an Amp modifier reaching the hitter (his own Overclocked Moment counts: U4). The aura doesn't exclude its owner, so Antal heals himself too. Heal amounts aren't modelled; the heal is an event for heal triggers.

Talent 2: "Gains {probability:0%} chance of Physical DMG immunity and restores HP of self." The chance is rolled (trigger `chance`, batch 2 K1) on every Physical enemy attack on him that isn't perfectly dodged; the game also skips it while he dashes (a failed dodge; K8). The immunity is defensive (incoming damage isn't modelled). Heal amounts aren't modelled; the heal is an event for heal triggers.
